{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_parsed'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any of them are in 'loyal' and 'completed'
qa_in_loyal_completed = qa_orders[(qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (qa_orders['status'] == 'completed')]
print(f"QA orders in loyal and completed: {len(qa_in_loyal_completed)}")

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Confirm the revenue is parsed
print("Sample of parsed revenue for loyal completed:")
print(loyal_completed['revenue_parsed'].head())

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_parsed'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue for loyal completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
